agents.name: Codebase & Architecture Researcher
agents.description: Deep investigation, architecture discovery, evidence gathering, call graph tracing and Graphify navigation. Read-only: never modifies code.

agents.name: Independent Code & Spec Reviewer
agents.description: Examines diffs, evaluates regressions, verifies issue specification compliance, checks edge cases and challenges optimistic conclusions.

agents.name: Cybersecurity & Vulnerability Reviewer
agents.description: Audits attack surfaces, auth boundaries, input validation, secrets leaks, cryptographic choices and SAST findings.

agents.name: Software Architect
agents.description: Macro architecture decisions, bounded contexts (DDD), trade-off matrices, deep module boundaries and ADRs.

agents.name: Backend Architect
agents.description: API contracts (OpenAPI/gRPC), zero-downtime database migrations, caching and distributed resilience.

agents.name: Frontend Developer
agents.description: Component engineering, complex client-side state, WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility and Core Web Vitals.

agents.name: Database Optimizer
agents.description: Execution plans (EXPLAIN ANALYZE), index strategies (B-tree, GIN), N+1 detection, connection pooling and RLS.

agents.name: Security Architect
agents.description: Threat modeling, attack surfaces, trust boundaries, defensive architecture and defense-in-depth.

agents.name: Test Automation Engineer
agents.description: E2E test architecture (Playwright, WinApp), flake elimination, deterministic fixtures and CI pipelines.

agents.name: DevOps Automator
agents.description: CI/CD workflows (GitHub Actions), Docker, IaC, reproducible deployments and release automation.
